{{Quote|<nowiki />''[&hellip;]'' Contispex and his successors exploited prohuman sentiment for increasingly violent jihads on what was then its periphery. His opening target was the perennially unpopular Hutt Empire ''[&hellip;]''<nowiki />|Doctor Gabrel Treon, "Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes"|<ref name="Tinker" />}}
The '''First Pius Dea Crusade''' was the first of a series of [[Pius Dea Crusades|military campaigns]] launched by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] while under the control of the [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentric]] [[Pius Dea]] cult. Sanctioned in [[11,965 BBY]] by the Republic's Pius Dea [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Contispex I/Legends|Contispex]], the crusade targeted [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], the realm of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]], which had long been unpopular with the Republic. The First Pius Dea Crusade ushered in dozens of other crusades during the subsequent [[Pius Dea Era|millennium]] that were aimed at various non-[[Human/Legends|Human]] species and had long-lasting repercussions on the relations between the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and [[Rim]]ward regions.

==Prelude==
In [[11,987 BBY]],<ref name="EGTW" /> the [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentrist]] religious sect [[Pius Dea]] brought about the impeachment of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Pers'lya]] and the election of its member, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Contispex I/Legends|Contispex]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Galactic History 19: The Pius Dea Crusades}}</ref> He began a [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]]-long process of achieving effective Pius Dea control over the Republic's institutions, including its [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The cult exploited pro-[[Human/Legends|Human]] sentiment in the Republic<ref name="Tinker" /> as well as tensions within the<ref name="Codex" /> long-unpopular [[Hutt Empire|empire]]<ref name="Tinker" /> of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]], members of which for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] had preyed on Republic [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] at its periphery, beyond the region known as the [[Rim]].<ref name="EGTW" /> Those tensions had arisen in the wake of<ref name="Codex" /> the series of calamities and catastrophes known as the [[Hutt Cataclysms]], which had caused disarray in the Hutt domains<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> by [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==The crusade==
In [[11,965 BBY]], Contispex sanctioned a pre-emptive strike against the Hutts<ref name="EGTW" /> in the form of an invasion of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="Tinker" /> In what became known as the first of the [[Pius Dea Crusades]], [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic forces]] originating in the centermost territory controlled by their government,<ref name="EGTW" /> in what would later be known as [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]],<ref name="Slice" /> advanced beyond the Republic's borders toward Hutt Space. The attacks traversed [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] along the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] and were also launched from two of the Republic's [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] outposts situated outside its territory&mdash;[[Ord Wylan]] and [[Ord Yndar]], the former of which served as the origin point for an advance toward the [[Toydaria system/Legends|Toydaria system]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|<nowiki />''[&hellip;]'' the ''[Pius Dea]'' program soon expanded to unbelievers of less evident threat.|Doctor Gabrel Treon, "Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes"|<ref name="Tinker" />}}
Under the biological and ideological<ref name="Codex" /> [[Contispex dynasty|dynastic successors]] of Contispex&mdash;who would eventually become known as Contispex I&mdash;during the subsequent [[Pius Dea Era|millennium]], the Republic carried out at least [[Thirty-Fourth Pius Dea Crusade|thirty-four]] crusades at various regions along the Republic's borders. The [[Third Pius Dea Crusade|Third Crusade]] of [[11,939 BBY]] was once again aimed at the Hutts, but eventually the Pius Dea began to target other species neighboring&mdash;and constituting&mdash;the Republic as well,<ref name="EGTW" /> undoing [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]]-worth of cultural integration<ref name="TEA" /> and deepening tensions between the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and Rim regions that would go on to last for tens of thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> In [[104 ABY]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Gabrel Treon]] noted the initial targeting of the Hutts by the Pius Dea Republic in the article "[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes]]," published in the [[Byblos Journal of Historical Science]].<ref name="Tinker" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[2005]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Kevin J. Anderson]] was the first source to mention the Pius Dea Crusades.<ref name="NEC" /> "[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji]]," an article authored by [[Nathan O'Keefe]] and published as part of the [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature on [[February 5]], [[2009]], gave the first indirect mention of the first of those conflicts specifically,<ref name="Tinker" /> and it was finally identified by the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> In the endnotes for "Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji," O'Keefe commented that the Hutts being the target of the first Pius Dea Crusade "makes sense," characterizing members of the species as a "problem" that [[Pre-Republic era|pre-dated]] the [[Galactic Constitution Conference|foundation]] of the Galactic Republic.<ref name="TTSP endnotes">{{Blog|valinkenobi|14/comments|TTSP Endnotes: Volume 1}}</ref>
